items.source: ElevenLabs provides natural-sounding speech synthesis software using deep learning. Its AI audio models generate realistic, versatile, and contextually-aware speech, voices, and sound effects across 32 languages. The ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API enables users to bring any book, article, PDF, newsletter, or text to life with ultra-realistic AI narration.
items.translation: ElevenLabs 提供基于深度学习的自然语音合成软件。其人工智能音频模型能够生成逼真、多功能且具备上下文感知能力的语音、声音和音效，支持 32 种语言。ElevenLabs 文本转语音 API 使用户能够将任何书籍、文章、PDF、通讯或文本转化为栩栩如生的超真实 AI 旁白。
